name: Sara Timberlain
summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain sews gear for Stormwind's soldiers. She makes useful armaments from salvaged cloth and leather.

sections.title: Needlework on the Frontier
sections.body:
On the western edge of Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain sews outside a small cottage. Axes ring through the camp as workers fell trees. Though the settlement lies far from other settled lands, wolves and murlocs prowl nearby. Sara still welcomes travelers.

She turns scraps of linen and salvaged bandanas into sturdy gear. Her skill has earned official recognition. Stormwind's military forces commission her to supply armaments made of cloth and leather.

faq.answer: Sara Timberlain is a skilled seamstress at Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. She makes practical gear from reclaimed fabrics and has contracts to supply the Stormwind Army.

faq.q: Where can I find Sara Timberlain?
faq.answer: Sara Timberlain sits outside a house on the western side of Eastvale Logging Camp. The camp lies in eastern Elwynn Forest along the road to Redridge.

faq.q: Why is Sara gathering cloth for the army?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Army relies on local crafters to maintain its equipment stores. Sara uses salvaged cloth, including linen gathered by travelers, to make sturdy garments and armor linings for the kingdom's soldiers.

angles.text: Sara shows how frontier tailors turn scraps of rough linen and bandit cloth into useful garments for military commissions.
Outlying settlements such as Eastvale help defend the kingdom. Local craftspeople supply basic armor to the under-resourced Stormwind Army.
